declarations.name: RegularLayout
declarations.summary: Resizable panel layout driven by a serializable split/tab tree.

methods.name: openPanel
methods.description: Insert `name` if it is not laid out yet, then select it — the one-call "open this tab", made for spaday's Invoke action.

methods.name: ensurePanel
methods.description: Place an absent panel beside a tab stack, then select it. Preserve existing placements.

declarations.name: RegularLayoutFrame
declarations.summary: Named draggable panel frame inside a RegularLayout. Its content area (::part(container)) is display: block with a definite height, so slotted content fills it with height: 100%, not flex: 1.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Panel name referenced by the layout tree.

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: Min frame width in px, rem, em, or percent of the layout.

attributes.name: preferred-width
attributes.description: Preferred frame width in px, rem, em, or percent of the layout.

attributes.name: max-width
attributes.description: Max frame width in px, rem, em, or percent of the layout.

attributes.name: min-height
attributes.description: Min frame height in px, rem, em, or percent of the layout.

attributes.name: preferred-height
attributes.description: Preferred frame height in px, rem, em, or percent of the layout.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Max frame height in px, rem, em, or percent of the layout.
